component.name: Red
component.summary: YouTube, in a real desktop app

description.p: Red puts YouTube in a native window built on Qt 6 and Qt WebEngine — lightweight, fast, and free of the browser tab. It adds what a browser cannot: a living-room TV mode, ad and tracker blocking, SponsorBlock, media keys, a mini player, and a real download manager.

ul.li: Desktop mode: the full YouTube site, signed in, with light/dark/system themes
TV mode: YouTube's smart-TV interface with keyboard, mouse and gamepad control
Ad and tracker blocking that never touches playback; SponsorBlock segment skipping
Downloads powered by yt-dlp: any video, playlist or channel, video or audio, with subtitles, thumbnails and chapters embedded
Media keys and desktop media controls (MPRIS); keeps the screen awake while playing
Mini player that floats above other windows; tray icon with playback controls

screenshot.caption: Desktop mode with a video playing, dislike count and SponsorBlock markers
TV mode: YouTube's living-room interface, driven by keyboard or gamepad
The downloads panel beside the page
Download dialog: video, audio only or exact streams, with playlist detection
Blocking: ads, trackers, SponsorBlock categories, dislikes and Shorts

description.p: Red 10 is a redesigned Red on Qt 6 and Qt WebEngine.

ul.li: Desktop and TV modes in one window, switchable at any time
Ad and tracker blocking that never touches playback; SponsorBlock; Return YouTube Dislike; Hide Shorts
Downloads: video, audio only or exact streams, playlists and channels, subtitles, thumbnails and chapters embedded, sign-in reused for restricted videos
Media keys, MPRIS, tray controls, mini player, screen kept awake while playing
A new design that follows YouTube's light and dark themes
